title: Attendance logs and ingestion troubleshooting
content: When attendance logs are missing for a date range, verify the requested dates, timezone, and nightly ingestion job status. A timeout does not prove resolution; escalate with the job identifier when ingestion remains incomplete.

title: Corporate authentication, SSO, and two-factor recovery
content: For corporate SSO, SAML assertion, or two-factor authentication failures, verify the user's identity and tenant authentication policy before resetting an authenticator. Never request a password, OTP, recovery code, or private credential.

title: n8n signed report export troubleshooting
content: For an n8n report-export 401 or signature mismatch, compare the UTC timestamp, unique event ID, report:export capability, canonical JSON body, and HMAC-SHA256 configuration. Do not expose the shared secret in logs.

title: Billing invoice questions
content: For invoice questions, verify the invoice period and billing account before escalating to finance. This article does not apply to attendance, authentication, or webhook failures.
